text:
Maya: okay team tiny goat photo dump time — my foster kid Nora jumped in my hoodie and refused to leave. dropping pics below.
Owen: no way. DROP.
Lina: Nora??? :heart_eyes: is that her name??
Maya: yes! Nora. she’s three weeks and thinks my shoelaces are snacks. pic: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T12345-F67890/nora_hoodie.jpg (she’s wrapped like a burrito)
Carlos: omg the ears. hoodie fits better than i do. :joy:
Owen: vote: hoodie or tiny saddle for Nora? (i vote hoodie)
Lina: hoodie forever. also can we get a slo-mo of the head tilt pls
peanut-bot: :tada: Cute alert logged to #pet-archive (id: goat-193950)
Maya: adding a short vid: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T12345-F67891/nora_zoom.mp4 — she photobombed my standup and then fell asleep on the keyboard.
Carlos: where do you even foster goats in the city?? details pls, might be able to help with weekend pickups
Maya: it’s a local rescue — PM me if you’re near SF. they do short-term fosters.
Owen: thanks for the serotonin boost, Maya. she’s the CEO of Cuteness. :sparkles:
Lina: +1 to CEO. also tagging @all for mandatory look because morale.
Maya: will accept more hoodie donations and snacks (non-chocolate).
peanut-bot: reaction summary: :heart: x12, :laughing: x3
Carlos: gentle reminder to keep hallway doors closed — goat Houdini powers activated around open doors :sweat_smile:
Maya: noted! closing doors, donating an extra hoodie. thanks y’all :)
